visual.description: Single centered column with eyebrow label, large heading, subtext, and a floating UI mockup overlapping from below, with a secondary calendar sidebar panel partially visible on the left.
Two overlapping panels: a narrow left-side mini calendar and a dominant right-side document/modal panel, creating an asymmetric layered layout with no strict column grid.
Centered heading and subtext above a horizontal scrolling row of three equal-width gradient cards partially clipped at the right edge.
Left-aligned heading and body text, with two large unequal-width rounded gradient feature cards side by side below — one wider (left) and one narrower (right).
Left-aligned text block paired with a large centered gradient card; additional floating dropdown and integration cards overlap or sit outside the main card bounds.
Centered large heading with a circular hand-drawn accent around a word, centered subtext below, and a gradient banner peeking in from the bottom edge.
Two staggered overlapping panels — a wide event card on the left and a task sidebar panel on the right — with a second dark threads panel offset below-left creating a layered Z-depth composition.
Centered heading above a full-width dark app screenshot showing a week-view calendar with a right-side task inbox panel, transitioning from dark to a light gradient background below.
Centered two-line heading and two short body paragraphs on a clean off-white background, with no images or cards.
Left-aligned brand name with privacy/terms links, and right-aligned Twitter and LinkedIn icon links, creating a minimal two-end footer row.
